inj.note: Beck has yet to resume practicing and will miss a second consecutive game Sunday due to back spasms, paving the way for Josh Johnson to start against Washington. LaFleur added that a Week 13 return against the Eagles is in play for Beck, who made his first regular-season NFL start in a 34-6 Week 10 loss to the Rams. Beck's practice participation level leading up to that game will provide an indication regarding his potential availability.

news.h: Cardinals to start QB Josh Johnson again with Carson Beck (back spasms) out
news.d: Cardinals rookie QB Carson Beck will miss a second straight game as he recovers from back spasms, paving the way for veteran Josh Johnson to start vs. the Commanders.
